known_paths.cadence: Three mutually exclusive -3 actions exist in the Hit entry, so one entry invocation can execute at most one; below threshold the flow sets Timer=60, and NpcClearHitParam resets the counter. The handler multiplies timer by 30; the counter incrementer/countdown were not traced, so exact time window and per-day frequency remain unknown.

daily_reward_and_cap_findings.first_talk_of_day: 0xc84240 passes min(ContinuousTalkDays, 3) to 0xd34cb0 when TalkCountToday becomes 1; [PSEUDO].
daily_reward_and_cap_findings.missed_talk: The applicable day-change reset branch clears ContinuousTalkDays when TalkCountToday is zero; it removes the streak bonus without a visible Friendship decrement; [PSEUDO/native helper fixtures].
daily_reward_and_cap_findings.storage: EventFlagsNpcMemoryParam sets Friendship default 25/max 255 and ContinuousTalkDays default 0/max 7; these are storage bounds, not an aggregate daily Friendship cap; [TBL].
daily_reward_and_cap_findings.delivery_timeout: NNPC_Quest_Delivery_TimeOver has conditional -1/-2/-3 EventFlow actions. This is a quest timeout penalty, not passive neglect decay; [EF].
daily_reward_and_cap_findings.aggregate_cap_evidence: All 72 indexed AddFriendship AddValue arguments are forwarded unchanged; the generic writer has no visible daily accumulator/gate. Friendship max 255 is a storage bound. No aggregate daily cap is identified in the indexed direct-writer/EventFlow evidence; indirect/dynamic writes and absent modules remain outside scope.
daily_reward_and_cap_findings.no_talk_decay: The documented missed-talk reset removes ContinuousTalkDays and shows no Friendship decrement; no passive no-talk decrement has been identified.
